identity: Long-form instrumental in B minor at 142 BPM: a lone electric-piano figure gathers tape-saturated drums and bowed strings, then thins to one held note.

sections.label: Electric piano figure alone over a soft room tone
Brushed ride and a low tom pulse join the figure
Bowed strings enter in long tones under the piano
Full kit arrives; the figure doubles in octaves
Drums return after a hollow stretch; strings swell
Climax with saturated drums and the figure at full width
Kit drops to the ride; strings thin to two voices
One held string note and the room tone fade out

do: Open with one figure alone and let it carry the first eighty seconds.
Add layers one at a time; let the drums leave and return once before the climax.
Keep the harmony circling B minor with the fourth and seventh as colour.
End by subtracting to a single sustained note rather than a cadence.
dont: Do not introduce the full kit before the strings have entered.
Do not modulate away from B minor.
Do not fade the ending in under twenty seconds.

uncertain: Whether the low tom pulse at 01:20 is played or sampled.
